title: VoiceReward
description: Plugin that rewards players for installing Simple Voice Chat mod.
body:
# VoiceReward

A Minecraft plugin that detects and rewards players for installing Simple Voice Chat mod.

## Features

* **One-Time Rewards** - Players receive rewards only once after mod installation
* **MiniMessage Format** - Supports modern [MiniMessage](https://docs.papermc.io/adventure/minimessage/format/) formatting
* **Customizable Actions** - Configure messages, sounds, and console commands

## Available Actions

| Action | Syntax | Description |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| `[MESSAGE]` | `[MESSAGE] <message>` | Sends a message to the command executor |
| `[BROADCAST]` | `[BROADCAST] <message>` | Broadcasts a message to all online players |
| `[CONSOLE]` | `[CONSOLE] <command>` | Executes a command from the console |
| `[PLAYER]` | `[PLAYER] <command>` | Executes a command as the player |
| `[EFFECT]` | `[EFFECT] <name;amplifier;duration>` | Applies a potion effect to the player |
| `[SOUND]` | `[SOUND] <name;volume;pitch>` | Plays a sound to the player |
| `[TITLE]` | `[TITLE] <title;subtitle;fadeIn;stay;fadeOut>` | Displays a title screen |

## Configuration Sections

- **aliases** - Command aliases (first one is the main command)
- **deny-actions** - Actions shown when a player doesn't have the mod
- **actions** - Actions executed when player installs the mod
- **already-claimed** - Actions shown when player already claimed the reward
